from typing import Annotated
import cyclopts

def deploy(
    target: str,
    token: Annotated[str, cyclopts.Parameter(help="API token", env_var="DEPLOY_TOKEN")]
) -> None:
    """Deploy application to target."""
    print(f"Deploying to {target} with token: {token}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    app = cyclopts.App()
    app.default = deploy
    app()
